headlines.title: Constellation Energy Sinks 10% in a Week, NuScale 17%, as “the Jensen Huang Stock Put Is Fading”
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysConstellation Energy fell 10% in the week to Nov. 25, along with NuScale Power and Bloom Energy, as Nvidia’s CEO saga swung AI stocks.

headlines.title: NEE or CEG: Which Clean Energy Stock Is Better Positioned for Growth?
headlines.summary: NEE and CEG stand to benefit from rising clean energy demand, but stronger earnings growth, better profitability and cheaper valuation give the latter an edge.

headlines.title: Constellation concludes 4.4GW natural gas-fired power plants sale
headlines.summary: The acquisition expands LS Power's presence in PJM, one of the largest wholesale electricity markets in the US.

headlines.title: How Investors May Respond To Constellation Energy Stock After Earnings Estimate Upgrades
headlines.summary: Constellation Energy has completed the sale of about 4.4 GW of largely natural gas generation in the PJM region to LS Power, meeting required divestitures tied to its earlier Calpine acquisition and reshaping its generation mix. The divestiture, together with stronger operating cash flow, rising earnings estimates and long term power contracts, tightens Constellation Energy’s focus on higher quality clean and contracted output rather than broad gas exposure.

headlines.title: 67% Upside for Constellation Energy? Morgan Stanley Thinks So, and Here’s How
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysMorgan Stanley kept its Overweight rating on Constellation Energy and raised its price target to $393 from $391, 67% above the stock’s price. Constellation is down 38% from its high last December, and Vistra has slid too, even though both raised their 2026 guidance.

description: Constellation Energy Corporation produces and sells energy products and services in the United States. The company operates through five segments: Mid-Atlantic, Midwest, New York, ERCOT, and Other Power Regions. It offers electricity, natural gas, energy-related products, and sustainable solutions. The company has approximately 31,676 megawatts of generating capacity consisting of nuclear, wind, solar, natural gas, and hydroelectric assets. It serves distribution utilities, municipalities, cooperatives, and commercial, industrial, public sector, and residential customers. The company was incorporated in 2021 and is headquartered in Baltimore, Maryland.
